title: README defers the app licence question to the release it ships in
observed: README says the licence for apps built with Tao "is being settled before the first public release", while the tutorial writes `license MIT`.
impact: A newcomer cannot tell whether they may license their own app.
expected: Release 1 states the licence terms for apps built with Tao.
recheck: Read the licence section in the release candidate.
notes: Relates to the Developer roadmap app-safe licensing prerequisite.
